blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. Sale and lease listings.

Commercial and industrial land for sale and lease in Abbotsford: lots and development sites listed on the MLS® as commercial land. Space for lease is included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.

items.t: The City’s 2017 Industrial Land Strategy named Special Study Areas A and B as the best places for future industrial land; Area B lies near Mt Lehman Road and the airport. ([City of Abbotsford, Industrial Land Strategy (April 2017)](https://www.abbotsford.ca/sites/default/files/2021-02/Industrial%20Land%20Strategy.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

Abbotsford is in the Fraser Valley Regional District, so it is not counted in Metro Vancouver’s industrial land inventory. ([Metro Vancouver 2025 Industrial Lands Inventory](https://metrovancouver.org/services/regional-planning/Documents/mv-industrial-lands-inventory-summary-report-appendices-2025.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: What sold: commercial land in Abbotsford
In the second quarter of 2026, 6 of the 18 commercial sales in Abbotsford were land properties, against 56 across the Lower Mainland.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
Smallest new lot by zone, Abbotsford
Each zone links to its full summary on the zoning guide. A zone that allows a use may still need a permit or a rezoning for a specific site, so check the address with the municipality before you buy.
